Lemon Herb Roast Chicken

Sunday lunch at our invented table always starts with this chicken.

Ingredients

  • 1 whole chicken (about 1.8 kg)
  • 2 lemons, halved
  • 4 cloves garlic, crushed
  • 2 tablespoons olive oil
  • 1 teaspoon dried thyme
  • salt to taste

Instructions

  1. Heat the oven to 200 °C.
  2. Rub the chicken with the oil, thyme and salt.
  3. Put the lemons and garlic inside the chicken.
  4. Roast for 1 hour 20 minutes and rest for 10 minutes.
